name: WeCom
summary: Post messages from Ogun workflows to a WeCom group through its group robot webhook. The key inside the URL is the secret.

fields.name: webhook_url
fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.help: The robot's URL, including its key query parameter. It is a secret. Store it with ogun secrets set.

operators.summary: Post a text message to the WeCom group the robot belongs to.

notes: The robot's key is a query parameter of the webhook URL, so the whole URL is stored as a secret and its query string never reaches logs, events or lineage. Anyone holding the URL can post to the group.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
